You seem gentle and kind. I would like to know more about you, my dear. Do you live alone?

It does get quiet in the evenings, so I understand missing someone to talk with. What country is your platform near, dear, and do you ever get a chance to make a voice or video call when the connection is better? Warm regards, Michael
